evals.name: pick-launch-date-b2b-analytics
evals.prompt: I'm a PMM planning a Tier 1 B2B analytics product launch. The product will be GA-ready in mid-June. What launch date should I pick? Walk me through the reasoning.
evals.expected_output: A specific recommended date in mid-to-late June or early-to-mid July with reasoning that references day of week (Tuesday or Wednesday preferred), avoidance of WWDC (June), Cannes Lions (mid-June), Memorial Day, and Independence Day week, time of day (7-8am PT / 10-11am ET), and at least two cross-check questions to validate.

assertions.text: Response recommends a Tuesday or Wednesday
Response names at least one industry event to avoid (WWDC, Cannes Lions, etc.)
Response explicitly avoids Memorial Day and/or Independence Day week
Response specifies a launch time in the 7-8am PT / 10-11am ET window
Response lists at least two cross-check questions (e.g. competitor windows, exec availability)
Response does NOT recommend launching on Monday or Friday

evals.name: launch-day-runbook-tier-1
evals.prompt: Write me a launch day runbook for a Tier 1 B2B launch on Thursday, July 17, 8am PT. Include T-1 day, launch day hour by hour through T+8 hours, dress rehearsal plan, and go/no-go criteria.
evals.expected_output: A runbook with T-1 day tasks (asset freeze, staging review, war room setup), launch day timestamps at T-2 hours, T-1 hour, T-0, T+15 minutes, T+1 hour, T+4 hours, T+8 hours with named owners per task, a dress rehearsal scheduled at T-5 days with a 90-minute agenda, and 4-6 go/no-go criteria with exec sign-off.

assertions.text: Runbook includes T-1 day, T-0, T+1 hour, T+4 hours, and T+8 hours checkpoints
Runbook includes a dress rehearsal at T-5 days
Runbook includes go/no-go criteria reviewed before launch week
Runbook names a war room channel or space
Tasks have named owners, not just 'team' or 'someone'
Runbook includes an asset freeze at T-1 day

evals.name: date-slip-recovery
evals.prompt: It's T-3 weeks from our Tier 1 launch. A sev-1 bug was just found and eng says it's a 2-week fix. Also, the VP of Marketing just told me the positioning isn't landing in customer interviews. What do I do?
evals.expected_output: A recommendation to slip the date. Specific reasoning that both issues together at T-3 weeks mean the launch won't land well. A concrete new date 3-4 weeks out. A plan covering: call a go/no-go immediately with exec sponsor, positioning reset work, press embargo renegotiation by calling each reporter individually, sales re-certification, go/no-go at the new T-1 week, and an explicit post-mortem commitment.

assertions.text: Response recommends slipping the date, not shipping on time
Response names a concrete new date range (typically 3-4 weeks out)
Response recommends individual calls to each reporter, not an email blast
Response includes sales re-certification on the new messaging
Response includes a post-mortem or debrief commitment
Response does NOT recommend ignoring the positioning concern and shipping anyway
